summary: Independent LLM review of the exact frozen candidate 0a2cae17f9154570 approves the stated scoped theorem and its complete proof. The midpoint relation on integer bases gives paired scalar thresholds with average equal to the middle threshold. A point outside the closed small-endpoint cap yields a strict inequality for the partner threshold. Homothetic partner caps then pay the entire good-set volume. Distinct physical bases are explicitly required before summing. The ordinary Hadamard estimate uses column stochasticity and AM-GM on row sums, whose total is d+1. The centered estimate deletes an actual good row, so every missed positive logarithmic weight remains charged. For alpha<1/3 an all-missed simplex would fit inside an inverted simplex of volume strictly less than 2^-d V. Chebyshev and Jensen apply because logarithmic weights and canonical own-cap volumes have the same ordering. The lower bound for the sum of log-positive weights is valid even when some weights vanish. The dimension split and exact constants were checked: for d<=9 the correction exceeds 53/1116, while for d>=10 monotonicity of (x+1)(1-exp(-64 log(2)/x)) and the stated integer cube comparison give a correction greater than 1/200. The score functions are continuous and strictly decreasing because each small endpoint is full dimensional and each support maximum is a nonconstant affine function of its point. Their threshold coordinates sum to more than one, giving one deterministic middle point with the 1/400 gain for every canonical direction and every integer tilt. The d=1 choice alpha=min(2^-64,E) satisfies all per-pair requirements and gives a threshold sum at least one, hence all continuous orientations. Pure integer caps contain the middle and at least one whole endpoint of each pair. Empty endpoint families and E=0 are treated separately. The statement is restricted to positive canonical continuous orientations when d>=2. V is a reference mass and is not identified with total mixed mass divided by 2^n. No unrestricted OC conclusion is claimed.
